strengths: Correctly identifies the glutamatergic, non-GABAergic lineage rather than only the generic neuronal parent.
Top-2 subtype description explicitly highlights L2/3 IT PTPRQ excitatory neurons, matching the observed marker panel.
Marker interpretation correctly discounts HOPX/LAMB1/COL5A2/COL24A1 as non-lineage-defining signals.
weaknesses: Top-1 label remains at glutamatergic neuron granularity and does not encode the strongly supported L2/3 IT refinement.
No single CL ID was confidently mapped from the raw label.

strengths: Rank-2 candidate CL:4030059 (L2/3 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron) is the best-supported finalized identity.
The neuron-level call is a correct ontology ancestor and therefore not a lineage error.
weaknesses: Top-1 label is too generic and omits the positive glutamatergic and layer/subtype evidence.
The most informative supported identity is present only at rank 2, not as the primary prediction.

strengths: Enrichment output is consistent with neuronal identity via synapse and axon-guidance terms.
weaknesses: No independent cell-type prediction was returned, so it cannot be evaluated as a competing annotation.

supporting: Top DEGs include CUX2, CBLN2, PTPRQ, ROS1, MCHR2, CNGB1, GRB14, GLRA3, ONECUT2, TCERG1L, ADAMTS3/16, a recognized L2/3 IT glutamatergic neuron panel (PMID 38034497, 38264721).
CL:4030059 is an ontology-valid descendant of glutamatergic neuron (CL:0000679) and neuron (CL:0000540), and every added layer/intratelencephalic component is supported by observed markers.

Original enrichment is dominated by neuronal signaling terms (neuron-to-neuron synapse, Schaffer collateral-CA1 synapse, axon guidance, nervous system development), consistent with the marker-based identity.
conflicting: In-house top-1 CL:0000540 is correct but under-resolved, failing to capture the positive glutamatergic/layer evidence.
LAMB1, COL5A2, and COL24A1 could superficially suggest stromal/ECM contamination, but they are outweighed by the coherent neuronal marker panel and do not define the cluster.
enrichment_or_literature: Original enrichment returned synapse, axon-guidance, and nervous-system-development terms, supporting the neuronal identity.
PMID 38034497 and 38264721 support human cortical glutamatergic neuron taxonomy and L2/3 IT subtype markers.

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
